COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
17.12.2025 C528 No.2243 of 2025
Hon’ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.
This Application has been filed for 
quashing the entire proceedings of 
Criminal Case No.1197 of 2025, pending 
before the court of learned Judicial 
Magistrate/IInd Additional Civil Judge 
(Junior Division), Haldwani, District 
Nainital under Section 323 and Section 
498A of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
2. Heard Mr. Sumit Bajaj, learned 
counsel for the applicants and Mr. 
Pradeep Lohani, learned Brief Holder for 
the respondent no.1. 
3. Mr. Sumit Bajaj, Advocate 
submitted that the allegations of the 
respondent no.2-informant levelled
against the applicants are false, 
fabricated and concocted. The applicant 
no.1 is the brother-in-law (Jeth) of the 
respondent no.2 and the applicant no.2 
is wife of the applicant no.1. They are 
residing in Delhi. 
4. Notice is being issued to the 
respondent no.2. Steps to be taken 
within a week. 5. List on 19.02.2026. Till then, 
further proceedings of Criminal Case 
No.1197 of 2025 are stayed qua the 
applicants, Shitiz Upreti & Smt. Disha 
Upreti alias Deepa Upreti.
6. The applicant no.1 and the 
respondent no.2 are directed to appear 
in-person before this Court on 
19.02.2026.
 (Alok Kumar Verma, J.) 17.12.2025
JKJ/Pant

COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
05.01.2026 C528 No.5 of 2026 
Hon’ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.
This Application has been filed by 
the applicants under Section 528 of the 
Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 
2023 for quashing the entire proceedings 
of Criminal Case No.1197 of 2025, “State 
Vs. Kamal Upreti and Others”, pending 
before the Judicial Magistrate/IInd
Additional Civil Judge (Junior Division), 
Haldwani, District Nainital under Sections
323, 498A of the Indian Penal Code, 
1860, Section 3 and Section 4 of the 
Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961. 
2. Heard Mr. Sumit Bajaj, learned 
counsel for applicants and Mrs. Sweta 
Badola Dobhal, learned Brief Holder for 
respondent no.1.
3. Mr. Sumit Bajaj, Advocate, has 
submitted that the applicant no.1 is the 
husband of the respondent no.2-
informant. Applicant no.2 is the mother 
and the applicant no.3 is the father of 
the applicant no.1. The allegations of the 
respondent no.2 are false. The applicant 
no.1 has filed a divorce suit, which is  pending before the Family Court, 
Karkardooma Courts, Delhi. The present 
FIR is a counterblast to the divorce 
petition. 
4. Mrs. Sweta Badola Dobhal, learned 
Brief Holder, has sought three weeks’ 
time to file counter affidavit. 
5. Time is granted. 
6. Notice is being issued to the 
respondent no.2.
7. Steps to be taken within a week. 
8. List on 19.02.2026 along with the 
record of C528 No.2243 of 2025. Till 
then, the further proceedings of the said 
Criminal Case No.1197 of 2025 are 
stayed qua the applicants. 
9. Applicant no.1 and the respondent 
no.2 are directed to appear in-person 
before this Court on 19.02.2026. 
 (Alok Kumar Verma, J.) 
 05.01.2026
Neha

Mr. Sumit Bajaj, learned counsel for the Applicants.
2. Mr. S.C. Dumka, learned AGA, for the State of 
Uttarakhand.
3. Ms. Surraya Naz, learned counsel holding brief of Mr. 
Lalit Sharma, learned counsel for the private Respondent.
4. Husband – Kamal Upreti and Wife – Poonam Upreti, 
are present in person before this Court.
5. After interacting with the parties, and after hearing the 
learned counsel for the parties, this Court is of the opinion 
that still there may be some reasonable grounds that the 
parties may come into the terms of the compromise, and settle 
their dispute amicably. Husband – Kamal Upreti, at the outset 
makes a statement that there is unnecessary mending by the 
relatives of his wife, and the reasons of his anonymity is that 
wife left his house without any considerable reasons, whereas 
the wife – Poonam Upreti, in turn also makes a similar 
statement that on instigation of the in-laws, the husband does 
not behave as he should, and thus, this is the main reason of 
their differences.
6. In considerate opinion of this Court, the matter is not 
such that it cannot be resolved.
7. Since the Husband – Kamal Upreti, has come all the 
way from Delhi, and the Wife – Poonam Upreti, is also 
present in person before this Court, the matter is referred  immediately to the Mediator, State Legal Services Authority, 
for mediation between the parties. Let a report in this regard 
be also filed.
8. List this matter on 19.03.2026.
 (Ashish Naithani, J.)
19.02.2026
Nitesh/
